app.name: Paperdesk
app.tagline: Practice trading with virtual money against live prices.
app.footer: Paper trading only. No real money moves, and prices may be simulated.

connection.simulatedTitle: The live feed is unavailable, so prices are generated by the server
connection.pausedTitle: No new prices for a few seconds. Market orders are refused until prices resume.

markets.title: Markets
markets.changeHint: Change since you opened this page

ticket.title: Place an order
ticket.marketHint: Fills right away at the best {{touch}}.
ticket.limitHint: Waits until the price reaches your limit, then fills at your price.

validation.quantity_step: Quantity must be a multiple of {{step}}.
validation.price_tick: Price must be a multiple of {{tick}}.
validation.min_notional: Order value must be at least {{min}} {{quote}}.
validation.insufficient_funds: Not enough cash. You can spend up to {{max}} {{quote}}.
validation.no_market_data: No live price yet for this market.

reasons.no_market_data: There's no live price for this market yet. Try again in a moment.
reasons.stale_market_data: The price feed paused, so the order wasn't filled. Try again in a moment.
reasons.insufficient_funds: Not enough available cash for this order.
reasons.insufficient_position: You don't hold enough of this asset to sell that much.
reasons.below_min_notional: The order value is below the minimum for this market.
reasons.too_many_open_orders: You have too many open orders. Cancel some before placing more.
reasons.invalid_quantity: That quantity isn't valid for this market.
reasons.invalid_price: That price isn't valid for this market.
reasons.limit_price_not_allowed: Market orders can't have a price.
reasons.idempotency_key_reused: This order was already sent with different details.
reasons.order_not_open: This order already finished, so it can't be cancelled.
reasons.rate_limited: You're sending orders too quickly. Wait a second and try again.
reasons.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

toast.sessionReset: The server restarted, so you have a fresh paper account.

orders.none: No open orders. Limit orders wait here until the price reaches them.

history.title: History
history.noOrders: No orders yet. Place one from the Trade page.
history.noTrades: No trades yet. Fills appear here as soon as they happen.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.none: You don't hold anything yet. Buy something from the Trade page.
portfolio.reset: Start over with a new account
portfolio.markHint: Valued at the current bid, the price you could sell at now.
